lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately four longitudinal rows along the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a discernible grid pattern across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal edge and localized shadowing on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least two remoras attached to the ventral surface, appearing as elongated dark silhouettes against the lower body profile.
